content:
**Big B's Rest Stop** is a location in The Mire region of Appalachia.

This location consists of two buildings - a Super-Duper Mart and a Red Rocket.

The Super-Duper Mart contains a shop and a restaurant area. A locked (Picklock 0) floor Safe can be found behind the shop counter to the right of the Cash Register. There are stairs leading to the roof of the building which houses a small makeshift living area including a Bed.

The Red Rocket contains a Stash Box inside the building, with a Power Armor Station and Armor Workbench behind the building.

- Power Armor Chassis with T-series armor pieces - Can be found behind the Red Rocket, usually in the Power Armor Station.
- Potential Vault-Tec Bobblehead - On the roof of the Super-Duper Mart, under a Bed placed below the "R" of the signage.
- Potential Magazine - Inside the Super-Duper Mart, against the red striped northeastern wall, on the ground, beside the serving counter, close to a stepladder.
- Potential Armor Mod Plan - At the front entrance of the Super-Duper Mart, inside a magazine stand, on the lowest shelf on the right.
- Potential Armor Mod - Inside the Super-Duper Mart. In the far left corner, on a red shelf.
- Potential Recipe - Inside the Super-Duper Mart, behind the front counter.

Big B's Rest Stop appears in *Fallout 76*.
